shown.message:
I requested changes on `paper-repo`#5 (candidate-v1). The candidate predates my last figures and tables delivery. The only fix needed is for `paper-repo` to merge `dev` (b52d3df) into the candidate.

**What the candidate gets wrong.** It was built from 8b97814, before b52d3df. Three things in it are wrong:
- **Fig. 2 and Fig. 9 (A2) in-sample line:** it is called "optimistic, test-leaking", but it is not an upper bound everywhere. On MTEB-Eng grouped, in-sample is 0.479 and the leave-one-benchmark-out reference is 0.470. The new wording calls it a reference in which the factor model has seen the test row's targets.
- **Table 8 (A3) caption:** it says the transform is "chosen per data set on the training folds". It is chosen once per pool by majority over the outer folds, so it used every model of the pool.
- **Table 3 and Table 4 captions:** they don't say that the real-data tier for MTEB-Multi and HELM MMLU is computed in logit space. Table 3's caption now also says what "Rank" is.

No number changes.

**What I checked in the built PDF.** All figure text is at least 7 pt. The tables fit the text width and the build log shows no overfull boxes. The Table 1 and Fig. 5 captions are at 4 and 7 lines.

**Placement note for `paper-repo`, not blocking.** The main text cites Table 3, Table 4 and Figure 6 without saying they are in the Appendix. I suggested "Appendix Table 3" and the like.

I did not check whether the text's numbers match the tables. That belongs to `experiment-repo` and `paper-repo`.

All the changes are in my repo and in `paper-repo` `dev`.
